note: TRACKED BACKLOG COMPLETE (FEAT01 through FEAT03, 22 tracker issues DONE). FOUR rounds of the owner's manual-testing feedback have now closed, all 2026-08-24: round one (FEAT03-FEAT06, settings/i18n, nav redesign, category autocomplete, save UX + name uniqueness-as-warning); round two (FEAT07-FEAT08, Home charts, transaction colors + Record-closes-to-Home + name uniqueness upgraded to a HARD BLOCK, the one cited exception to NFR-4 in docs/fr-nfr.md/decisions.md); round three (FEAT09-FEAT10, a per-AccountGroup/TransactionKind color+icon system reused across Home's redesigned figure cards and two picker descriptions, plus a new in-app HelpScreen reached from every tab, Tooltip hints on Home's seven cards, and app-bar actions reorganized - Settings+Help on all five tabs, Categories only on Home+Transactions; a same-day post-close pass also fixed a card-overflow bug, added thousands/decimal separators, and hardened two more overflow-prone spots found by audit); round four (FEAT11, AccountGroup gains a fourth value PERSON whose owed-to-me/owed-by-me direction is decided fresh from its balance sign on every read rather than fixed at creation - confirmed NOT a schema migration since Accounts.group has no CHECK constraint - plus the Lend/Borrow/Repay person-picker becomes autocomplete-with-inline-create with a checkbox controlling the created type, and Repay gained an explicit plain-worded 'who paid' toggle for PERSON-group debts only). App test suite: 197 tests green (was 151 at the start of this session's feedback work). Nothing is queued or runnable - no issue to dispatch next. NOTES carried forward, still relevant for any future work in this repo: (1) sequence .mmd sources are NOT persisted; (2) sequence renders live in their OWNING ISSUE's folder; (3) renders.lock can go stale silently after an as-built XML edit - re-run `python audit.py --record-renders` at close; (4) map.yaml's ucs: lists must be real workbook UC codes only, never an issue id; (5) IndexedStack-based navigation means every FloatingActionButton needs an explicit unique heroTag - six across the app as of FEAT04, check for collisions before adding more; (6) a clean local audit.py pass does NOT prove CI will pass - only the actual CI log surfaces a glob()-ordering-dependent bug (fixed 2026-08-23); (7) BEFORE writing a new screen/class, check the relevant class diagram has a box for it - flutter-coder halting on FEAT04's AccountsScreen is the model to follow; a genuinely private per-file widget or plain top-level function (like FEAT05's _CategoryAutocompleteField, FEAT09/FEAT10's group_style.dart/kind_style.dart/tab_app_bar_actions.dart, or FEAT11's _PersonAccountField) does NOT need a diagram entry - check whether the new thing is a tracked class (Screen/Provider/DAO/Notifier) or private/shared implementation detail before halting; (8) this project is a pilot run for a different target project (owner's own words, 2026-08-24) - the process trail itself is part of what gets extracted later, so keep the same discipline on these post-backlog polish items as on the original tracked issues; (9) a plain ListView(children: [...]) in a widget test does NOT build off-screen children automatically (Sliver-realized, not eager) - a widget test asserting on content below the fold must scroll first (tester.drag + pumpAndSettle), caught repeatedly across FEAT07/FEAT10's chart/card tests; (10) a subagent can hit its own session/usage limit mid-task and terminate without finishing - check `git status`/diff for partial, uncommitted work before assuming a 'failed' task notification means nothing was done; FEAT07's coder got the DAO layer fully done and correct before terminating, and that work was kept and built on rather than redone; (11) `flutter gen-l10n` is a SEPARATE required step from `dart run build_runner build` whenever an ARB file changes - build_runner alone leaves new l10n keys undefined and flutter analyze fails on undefined_getter; now documented in context/coding-conventions/dart-and-flutter.md; (12) when two issues both touch the same file (e.g. FEAT09 and FEAT10 both touch balance_sheet_screen.dart), dispatch their flutter-coder agents SEQUENTIALLY, not in parallel, to avoid two agents editing the same working-tree file at once; (13) not every enum-value addition is a schema migration - a textEnum column with no CHECK constraint accepts a new legal Dart-side value with nothing more than a build_runner regen; check for a CHECK constraint before reaching for drift_dev make-migrations (FEAT11); (14) `ref.read` inside a helper does NOT subscribe the calling widget to anything - if a value needs to update as a stream emits, something in build() must `ref.watch` it too, even if the read itself happens elsewhere (FEAT11's repay-direction-toggle default stayed stuck until this was added).
